analytics.title: Server Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Real-time stats on this server's activity. Data is computed from the logs collected since TookBot was invited.
analytics.chart_daily_sub: Events (commands + messages + actions) over the selected period.
analytics.chart_growth_sub: Joins, leaves and cumulative net over the period. Counted since the bot was installed.
analytics.heatmap_sub: Average activity by hour and weekday (last 4 weeks). The brighter the green, the more activity.
analytics.top_commands_sub: Most used slash commands on this server.
analytics.top_users_sub: Members with the most logged events.
analytics.insights_sub: CSV exports of the raw data + weekly cohort retention.
analytics.cohort_sub: % of members still active N weeks after joining.
analytics.paywall_text: CSV exports and cohort retention are reserved for TookBot+ subscribers.

automod.title: Auto-moderation
automod.subtitle: Enable filters to moderate your server automatically. Matching messages are deleted and logged in the admin channel.
automod.general_sub: Master switch: when it is off, no rule is applied.
automod.enabled_desc: Turns the whole system on. Turn it off to pause without losing your config.
automod.log_channel_desc: Text channel where automod posts an embed for every action.
automod.rules_sub: Enable the filters you want. Each rule has its own settings.
automod.banned_words_desc: Deletes any message containing one of the listed words (whole-word match, case-insensitive).
automod.invites_desc: Deletes Discord invite links (discord.gg/* or discord.com/invite/*).
automod.mention_spam_desc: Deletes messages with a high number of mentions (users + roles).
automod.raid_desc: Logs an alert if a high number of joins is detected within a minute (no auto-kick, to avoid false positives).
automod.preview_banner: ✦ You are previewing the TookBot+ feature · Actions are disabled.
automod.paywall_text: Auto-moderation is reserved for TookBot+ subscribers. Pick an option below.

cs2.heading: Counter-Strike 2
cs2.intro: Automatic rank role setup: assigns a Discord role based on each member's declared Premier tier (`/cs setrank`). Turn the feature on below and map a role to every tier.
cs2.rank_role_help_after: in Discord, the bot gives them the role matching their Premier tier (CS Rating).
cs2.toggle_help: The roles configured below are added or removed based on ELO.
cs2.mapping_help: Pick the Discord role to apply for each Premier tier.
cs2.cmd_queue: create a temporary voice channel (5 slots)

custom_commands.intro_before: Create your own commands, run with
custom_commands.intro_after: in Discord (direct slash). Plain text or structured embed (JSON).
custom_commands.advanced_help: For advanced fields (multiple fields), edit the raw JSON below directly.
custom_commands.label_raw_json: Raw JSON (optional — overrides the fields above)

duels.empty_hint: Pick a player from the list to view and edit their duel profile.
duels.shop_help: Edit an existing saber, add a new one, or remove one. Deleting also cleans up the collections that own it.

giveaways.heading: Giveaways
giveaways.intro: Create and run prize draws. The bot posts an embed with a "Join" button and automatically picks the winners when the timer ends.

logs.heading: Server logs
logs.intro: Trace of the slash commands that ran and of member actions (voice, deletions, edits, join/leave).

lol.title: League of Legends

lol.auto_assign_desc: The roles configured below are applied or removed based on the Solo/Duo tier.
lol.mapping_help: Pick the Discord role to apply for each tier.
lol.cmd_rank: Solo/Duo rank focus + auto rank role
lol.cmd_live: current game if in a match

mod_config.title: Moderator permissions

mod_config.intro_3: Without a config, mods can access

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.intro: Kick, ban and timeout members of your server. The bot needs the matching Discord permissions for the action to go through.
moderation.delete_messages: Delete messages from the last X hours
moderation.config_help: Warning threshold before an auto timeout, auto timeout duration, and the channel where sanctions are posted.

social_alerts.title: Twitch / YouTube / Reddit alerts
social_alerts.subtitle: The bot posts a message in the channel of your choice as soon as a creator goes live (Twitch), uploads a new video (YouTube) or posts on Reddit. Checked every 5 minutes.
social_alerts.link_help: Paste the full channel URL — the bot extracts the identifier automatically.
